manuscript/asah1_labels.title: Figure S15b · ASAH1 glycofeature identities
manuscript/asah1_labels.description: A01–A20 identify distinct peptide-plus-glycan features. All 20 conditional estimates are retained.

manuscript/candidate_sensitivity_coverag.title: Figure S14b · candidate sensitivity coverage
manuscript/candidate_sensitivity_coverag.description: Covariate-sensitivity availability for 27 of 81 primary conditional candidates: 24 selected features plus three ASAH1 glycoforms.

manuscript/glyco_labels.title: Figure 6d · glycofeature labels
manuscript/glyco_labels.description: The 20 displayed glycofeatures with complete peptide and glycan identities and both effect columns.

manuscript/phospho_labels.title: Figure 6c · phosphosite labels
manuscript/phospho_labels.description: The 14 displayed phosphosites with complete feature identities and both effect columns.

manuscript/ptm_calibration_replicates.title: Figures S18–S20 · per-replicate calibration metrics
manuscript/ptm_calibration_replicates.description: 250 simulated datasets × six quantities. Literal null denotes the null scenario; these are simulated quantities, not patient records.

manuscript/ptm_calibration_summary.title: Figures S18–S20 · PTM calibration summary
manuscript/ptm_calibration_summary.description: Six quantities, five scenarios and two scopes: all completed versus numerically adequate fits. Figure S18 shows coverage, S19 bias and S20 RMSE. Coverage bars are Wilson confidence intervals, not HDIs. No screen-wide false-discovery control.

manuscript/ptm_calibration_templates.title: Figures S18–S20 · calibration by template
manuscript/ptm_calibration_templates.description: Separate phospho and glyco template results; aggregate summaries across simulated replicates.

manuscript/ptm_heatmap_lookup.title: Figures 6c,d · PTM heatmap identities and estimates
manuscript/ptm_heatmap_lookup.description: All 14 phospho and top 20 of 67 glyco conditional candidates. Gene, site/peptide/glycan, both effects and pointwise HDIs; magnitude-ranked without multiplicity control.

manuscript/ptm_sbc_bins.title: Figure S21a · SBC rank histogram counts
manuscript/ptm_sbc_bins.description: Pointwise 95% binomial reference limits are not simultaneous bands or a formal calibration test.

manuscript/ptm_sbc_values.title: Figure S21a · SBC ranks
manuscript/ptm_sbc_values.description: Prior-predictive SBC ranks for 50 simulated datasets × six quantities. Randomized ties use seed 20261004.

manuscript/rna_heatmap_values.title: Figure 3a · RNA heatmap values
manuscript/rna_heatmap_values.description: Displayed continuous RNA coefficients for the 24 selected signature rows. Unmodeled combinations remain missing. The named examples in Figures 3b–e are available in the compartment RNA effects collections.

manuscript/rna_protein_heatmap_values.title: Figure 5e · RNA–protein heatmap values
manuscript/rna_protein_heatmap_values.description: Displayed paired-model RNA and protein slopes and direct protein-minus-RNA contrasts.

manuscript/rna_protein_labels.title: Figure 5e · RNA–protein programme labels
manuscript/rna_protein_labels.description: RP01–RP16 link displayed labels to unique measured programmes and source signatures.

manuscript/sensitivity_classifications.title: Figure S22b · interval classifications
manuscript/sensitivity_classifications.description: Counts retained or changed in each comparison among 24 post hoc features. Both compared fits must be numerically adequate.

manuscript/sensitivity_comparisons.title: Figures S23–S24 · matched sensitivity comparisons
manuscript/sensitivity_comparisons.description: 192 comparisons. Figure S23: fixed plex, stage subset, stage adjustment and purity subset. Figure S24: purity adjustment, mutation adjustment, weight-loss exclusion and adenosquamous exclusion. Stage and purity adjustment use the matched unadjusted subset; restriction and other variants use the primary fit. Classification changes are descriptive, not posterior contrast tests.

manuscript/sensitivity_feature_labels.title: Figures S22–S24 · sensitivity feature identities
manuscript/sensitivity_feature_labels.description: E01–E24 map to the 24 post hoc selected features from CTSD, HLA-DRA, LAMC1, POSTN and GSDMD.

ptm/asah1_paired.title: ASAH1 · paired model quantities
ptm/asah1_paired.description: Primary protein, marginal PTM and conditional PTM effects, standardized slope differences, coupling and residual correlation. All 20 parent-protein BMI intervals include zero.

ptm/extended_sensitivity_effects.title: Figures S22–S24 · expanded PTM sensitivity estimates
ptm/extended_sensitivity_effects.description: 24 post hoc selected features, primary references and eight sensitivity variants. 192 refits; all numerically adequate. Figure S22a shows the overview; Figures S23–S24 show variant-specific comparisons. Use matched subsets for stage and purity adjustment.

ptm/extended_sensitivity_predictive.title: Expanded PTM sensitivity · predictive checks
ptm/extended_sensitivity_predictive.description: Saved predictive checks for the 192 refits. Sampling adequacy and predictive fit assess different aspects of a model.
